note: City of Oelwein campground in City Park on the south edge of town, beside 55-acre Lake Oelwein (no-wake; kayak and paddleboard rentals from the host). Use the south entrance off Highway 281. Sites are scattered under shade in the woods west of the lake's outlet creek, set back from the shore behind trees and a park road; not waterfront. Primitive tent area (4-night limit). The private Lakeshore RV Resort is a separate park on the lake's west side. --Claude

Not waterfront confirmed. Pin ~410 m off (east of the creek). Note rewritten.

The Rec1 catalog loads by script and was not read; window and rules unconfirmed.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. Lake Oelwein is 55 acres (Chamber). The pads sit under closed canopy west of the outlet creek; the nearest are ~40-50 m from the lake's south-west shore through trees with a park road along the shore between them; the creek below the dam is ~10-15 m wide and ~100 m from the south loop. No official campsite photos to show a view. Distances are imagery estimates.
